user.title: Aqara M1S Stock Lab
user.description: Use existing authorized Telnet access. Stock MQTT is reached internally through a second authenticated session, without a new LAN port or installation on the hub. Use only a trusted LAN. Do not connect ZoH/ZHA/Zigbee2MQTT to the stock coordinator UART.

init.title: Stock lab limits
init.description: Cleanup removes obsolete entities from this entry only, after valid inventory and sound discovery; missing children require two consecutive valid inventories. Unavailable status alone never triggers deletion. Telnet uses the existing internal stock broker; direct mode requires an already existing LAN endpoint. Audio levels above 5 and child control are opt-in and not physically validated.
